tasks.label: Run adversarial recommender profiles
args:
from src.recommender import load_songs, recommend_songs
songs = load_songs('data/songs.csv')
profiles = {
    'Conflicting signals': {'genre': 'rock', 'mood': 'chill', 'energy': 0.95, 'likes_acoustic': True},
    'High-energy melancholy': {'mood': 'melancholic', 'energy': 0.95, 'likes_acoustic': False},
    'Acoustic contradiction': {'genre': 'pop', 'mood': 'intense', 'energy': 0.9, 'likes_acoustic': True},
    'Unknown labels': {'genre': 'not-in-catalog', 'mood': 'not-in-catalog', 'energy': 0.5, 'likes_acoustic': False},
    'Boundary energy 0.0': {'energy': 0.0, 'likes_acoustic': False},
    'Boundary energy 1.0': {'energy': 1.0, 'likes_acoustic': False},
    'Out-of-range energy 1.5': {'energy': 1.5},
    'Out-of-range energy -0.5': {'energy': -0.5},
    'No preferences': {},
}
for name, profile in profiles.items():
    print(f'\\n{name}: {profile}')
    for rank, (song, score, explanation) in enumerate(recommend_songs(profile, songs, k=5), 1):
        print(f'{rank}. {song[\"title\"]} — {score:.1f} points ({explanation})')
